title: Automated Cash Flow Forecasting Software: 8 Best Tools for an Always-Current Cash Balance (2026, Reviewed and Compared)
summary: Compare eight automated cash flow forecasting tools by where the cash number comes from, how often it refreshes, scenario reach and who runs the rollout.
body_markdown:
*Updated November 2026*


The best automated cash flow forecasting software keeps your cash tied to your P&L and balance sheet and refreshes as your actuals refresh, so the cash balance you see is the one your plan runs on. Eight tools stand out: Abacum, BILL, Cashforce, Cube, Float, HighRadius, Tesorio and Trovata. They differ on where the cash number comes from (bank connections, accounting and ERP actuals, or the planning model), how much planning sits around it, and who runs the rollout.


Abacum is the AI-native FP&A platform finance trusts, and the business planning platform the whole company runs on. It runs on one governed layer of data, logic and context: data is the what, logic is the how, context is the why.


## Key takeaways


-


Decide what "always current" means for you. Daily bank-balance visibility and a forecast that updates when the plan changes are different jobs, and some teams need both.


-


A cash forecast that sits apart from the P&L and balance sheet goes stale the moment an assumption changes. Keeping all three statements in one model keeps them in step.


-


Check the source of the cash figure: bank connections, accounting or ERP actuals, or both.


-


Test multi-entity roll-ups and FX translation on your real entity structure.


-


Ask who owns the rollout and how long the first live forecast takes.

## What to look for in automated cash flow forecasting software


1.


**Cash source.** Bank connections, accounting or ERP actuals, or both. Daily bank-balance visibility and a forecast that updates when the plan changes are different jobs.


2.


**Refresh cadence.** Ask how often actuals refresh and from which systems.


3.


**Statement integration.** Cash should tie to the P&L and balance sheet, so a change in one assumption reaches all three.


4.


**Scenario reach.** A downside case should flow through to cash without manual links.


5.


**Multi-entity roll-ups.** Test roll-ups with FX translation on your real entity structure.


6.


**Rollout and security.** Ask who runs the implementation, how long the first live forecast takes, and which certifications are current. Abacum is SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant.


If your team works in spreadsheets today, an automated tool does not have to mean starting over. For a deeper look at cash balance tracking, see our guides to[real-time cash balance forecasting software](https://www.abacum.ai/blog/best-cash-flow-forecasting-software-real-time-cash-balance) and[real-time cash position tracking](https://www.abacum.ai/blog/cash-flow-forecasting-software-real-time-cash-position) .


## The eight platforms


### Abacum: cash, three statements and scenarios in one connected model


Abacum builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement from live ERP actuals and keeps cash forecasts and scenarios in the same connected model, so the cash view updates as actuals refresh. Multi-entity roll-ups use a dimension-based model, with currency translated at the FX rates you set. Implementation is finance-owned and runs six to nine weeks, depending on data complexity, entity count and workflows, guided by in-house FP&A experts. Abacum connects to 700+ integrations, including NetSuite, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business ByDesign, Sage Intacct, Xero and QuickBooks, through native, automated connections. Abacum's cash view comes from your ERP actuals and your plan, so confirm with every vendor how its cash figure is sourced.


**Best for:** finance teams running multi-entity, multi-location planning that want cash, the three statements and scenarios in one connected model.


### BILL: forecasting inside payables and receivables


BILL provides cash flow forecasting as part of its accounts payable and receivable automation platform, using payment data to project cash from scheduled payments and expected receipts.


**Best for:** teams already running payments in BILL that want forecasting in the same place.


### Cashforce: treasury-focused forecasting


Cashforce offers treasury-focused cash forecasting with working capital analysis and liquidity planning. It connects to ERPs and banks to aggregate cash data and forecast across time horizons, and it emphasizes configurable forecasting methods and business rules.


**Best for:** organizations with an active treasury function that want configurable, workflow-rich forecasting.


### Cube


Cube keeps live actuals, assumptions and scenarios maintained together, and supports direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling. It works with Excel and Google Sheets ([cubesoftware.com](https://www.cubesoftware.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams that want direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling.


### Float: rolling forecasts from your accounting system


Float forecasts cash for teams using cloud accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks and FreeAgent. It syncs with the accounting system to build rolling forecasts from actual transactions, invoices and bills.


**Best for:** teams on cloud accounting software that want straightforward cash visibility.


### HighRadius: AI-powered treasury and cash forecasting


HighRadius offers treasury and cash management with AI-powered cash forecasting. It connects to banks and ERPs and provides variance analysis that helps treasury teams see why forecasts deviate from actuals.


**Best for:** treasury teams managing global cash operations across many entities and currencies.


### Tesorio: forecasting tied to collections


Tesorio combines cash forecasting with accounts receivable automation. It predicts when customers will pay rather than when invoices are due, and it offers collection workflows to speed payment.


**Best for:** B2B teams where collections drive the cash position.


### Trovata: bank-connected cash visibility


Trovata focuses on cash visibility and forecasting. It connects to banks through open banking APIs and uses machine learning on historical cash flows to project positions.


**Best for:** teams that want bank-connected cash visibility without a legacy treasury system.
